content: SimpleInvoices (GPLv3 open-source since 2005, PHP, SQLite/MySQL/PostgreSQL): multi-language (41+) with per-invoice language, multi-currency (40+ presets) with locale-aware formatting, multi-domain SaaS, professional PDFs with logo and multiple templates, email PDFs, 9 payment gateways (Stripe/PayPal/Mollie/Coinbase), recurring invoices with auto-email, responsive web UI. Demonstrates the mature open-source baseline: templates+PDF+email+payments+recurring are all table stakes in this space.
